title: Turn remembered experience into useful agent guidance
description: Help agents derive and apply implied guidance from remembered experience, without requiring every instruction to be stated explicitly.

title: Define evaluations for learning and applying implied guidance
description: Establish a baseline and useful signal for iterative improvement. Evaluate deriving principles from experience and applying them to new decisions. Find a suitable case in local history and propose it to the user before using it. Exclude Coilpack and confirm the candidate’s licensing suitability.

title: Preserve decision rationale in session learning
description: Capture concise, informative decision rationale rooted in facts and observations, including corrections and rejected alternatives, with proper tmix citations. Use the agreed evaluations to guide improvements.

title: Derive and organize guiding principles through consolidation
description: Synthesize higher-level lessons from remembered decisions. Organize memory as a priority pyramid: a small set of the most important guiding principles leading into increasingly detailed lessons and evidence. Use the agreed evaluations to guide improvements.

title: Connect experience, principles, and performance through navigation
description: Link experiences to the lessons and principles derived from them. Factor recent agent performance into reorganizing those connections. Use the agreed evaluations to guide improvements. Retrieval changes are out of scope.

title: Simplify README and separate user and contributor reference guides
description: Approved README restructuring: concise onboarding, focused reference docs, retain canonical operating guide and agent copies, remove README generation. Verify docs generation and local links.
close_reason: README reduced from 812 to 100 lines; reference material moved to focused docs and CONTRIBUTING.md; README removed from generation while agent copies remain unchanged. Passed make docs docs-check, make test vet, local documentation link check, and git diff --check. No live installs, model calls, or scheduler changes.

title: Retain bounded learning-job failure history
description:
The investigation on 2026-11-17 could inspect only last_job.json and last_failure.json. These reports retain the latest invocation and retained failure, not a sequence of recent failures. The user requested the last few background job failures, but preceding errors and exact times could not be established from those files.

Add bounded local invocation/failure history sufficient to explain recent failures. Preserve safe underlying errors, timestamps, progress counts, and later-success context. Exclude raw transcripts, credentials, and sensitive harness output. Choose the retention and CLI presentation before implementation.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Agree on bounded retention and the diagnostic CLI output.
- [ ] Demonstrate multiple failures and a later success in isolated state.
- [ ] Preserve underlying safe errors, times, progress, and existing latest-report semantics.
- [ ] Cover interruption, concurrent access, and bounded history without transcript or credential storage.
- [ ] Pass focused regressions and make test vet.

title: Handle compressed Codex transcripts without false learning coverage failures
description:
Observed on 2026-11-17: learning schedule status reported 23 source/session errors with "session not found in latest scan". Each recorded .jsonl source had a .jsonl.zst replacement. All 23 sessions predated the learning cutoff and had no pending review turns.

The 14:00 UTC invocation completed four eligible turns across two sessions, but the worker still returned an overall failure. Later invocations continued to report the source errors. The last fully successful invocation was 2026-11-15T21:47:36Z.

Evidence: tmix learning schedule status; tmix learning sessions status; comparison of recorded source paths with their compressed replacements. learning/registry.go currently discovers only paths whose extension is .jsonl. learning/worker.go returns a coverage failure for retained session errors.

Decide the supported behavior for compressed sources before implementation. Preserve evidence resolution, session identity, review coverage, and explicit failure reporting. Do not silently mark missing evidence reviewed or drop genuine source errors.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Reproduce discovery and repeat-run behavior with isolated .jsonl.zst fixtures.
- [ ] Approve and implement compressed-source handling, including before-cutoff sessions.
- [ ] Preserve genuine missing/malformed-source errors and existing review/evidence invariants.
- [ ] Pass focused regressions and make test vet.
- [ ] Record implementation verification separately from installed scheduled-run verification.
close_reason: Reviewed and approved. Compressed Codex replacement regression and make test vet passed. Release and installed verification tracked in tmix-xys.

title: Handle Codex rollout segments sharing an internal session ID
description:
Observed during tmix-xys rollout verification on 2026-11-18. The launchd invocation ran 15:41:34–15:44:30 UTC, completed all 3 targeted turns across 2 sessions, but failed overall with 2 source/session coverage errors. First reported error: codex/01a14bd9-b544-7ba3-a029-c4b630551021: conflicting files with the same native session ID. The second coverage error was not independently identified. Previous 23 missing compressed-source errors were gone.

Conflicting sources under ~/.codex/sessions/2026/10/17/:
- rollout-2026-10-17T17-52-01-01a14bd9-b544-7ba3-a029-c4b630551021.jsonl.zst (16 records; 144443 decompressed bytes).
- rollout-2026-10-17T17-55-13-01a14bd9-b544-7ba3-a029-c4b630551021_01a14bdc-a3b6-76c3-8a49-876bc0f0a305.jsonl.zst (1264 records; 2697047 decompressed bytes).

Both session_meta payloads contain id and session_id 01a14bd9-b544-7ba3-a029-c4b630551021 and context_window.window_id 01a14bd9-b547-75a3-988b-7a932bebe1f5. Both originated from Codex Desktop 0.162.0-alpha.17.2, source vscode, thread_source user, cwd ~/remote-agent-workspace/oz. Metadata timestamps are 2026-10-17T21:52:01.404Z and 2026-10-17T21:55:13.462Z. The smaller file ends with turn_aborted; the larger begins with thread_settings_applied events then task_started. Contents differ; this is not an identical duplicate or established prefix extension. No explicit fork/parent/resume fields were found in payload keys. Restart/resume is a hypothesis, not a confirmed cause; the extra filename UUID does not prove a fork.

Read-only reproduction: tmix learning sessions status reports the conflict; find the two paths above, stream-decompress with zstd -dc, and inspect session_meta plus event structure. learning/registry.go currently marks different discovered sources with the same native identity as conflicting. No source files were changed. Determine Codex segment semantics before choosing a fix; do not automatically choose the longest/newest file or assume they can be concatenated.

Follow-up to closed tmix-xys and tmix-icv. Last fully successful invocation remained 2026-11-15T21:47:36.46759Z. User requested tracking only; no implementation or scheduler changes authorized by this issue.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce with isolated synthetic rollout files, including compressed sources. Establish supported continuation/fork identity semantics before implementation. Preserve genuine divergent-copy errors, source evidence, cutoff eligibility, and review progress; do not silently discard or duplicate turns. Cover aborted-then-restarted segments and repeated scans. Pass focused regressions and make test vet; verify installed-job recovery separately.

title: Release and verify compressed-transcript recovery in the scheduled job
description:
Depends on the compressed-transcript fix. This task tracks rollout, not further implementation. Preserve separate evidence for code tests, release artifacts, installed executable identity, and a real scheduled invocation.

Obtain approval before release publication, deployment, or scheduler changes. Do not close this task merely because a source build or manual unit test succeeds.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Record the approved fix commit and release/artifact verification.
- [ ] Obtain rollout approval and install the approved executable at its stable path.
- [ ] Verify the scheduler uses the intended executable and configuration.
- [ ] Observe a real scheduled invocation without the known compressed-source coverage errors.
- [ ] Record completion time, remaining errors or workload, and later-success status before closing.
close_reason: Verified reinstalled fix 6039249 via actual launchd invocation completed 2026-11-18T15:44:30Z: previous 23 missing compressed-source errors gone, all 3 targeted turns complete. Remaining 2 coverage errors include conflicting native session ID; overall job still failed and no later full success. Compressed-source rollout verified; broader learning health remains unresolved.
